name: Washcoating - Catalyst on Monolith / Honeycomb
description: A milled slurry of the catalyst powder and binder is coated onto a ceramic or metal honeycomb, blown clear, dried and calcined. The route for automotive three-way, diesel oxidation and SCR converters.
source: Nijhuis, Beers, Vergunst et al., Preparation of monolithic catalysts, Catal. Rev. 43, 345 (2001); Beale et al., Top. Catal. 56, 1441 (2013)
route_note: The coating pass itself has no Step Library rate, so this route costs the slurry, milling, drying and calcination and says so. The honeycomb substrate is a material input.
uncosted_operations: Dip-coating or vacuum-assisted coating line: no Step Library rate, the coating pass is not costed
Honeycomb substrate (cordierite or metal foil) enters as a material, not a step
